units.source_text: 我们的生存确实是被持续一定时间的凝固物所包围而保存着的。

en.t: Our existence is indeed preserved by being surrounded by things that have solidified over a certain span of time.

units.source_text: 譬如，木匠只为家务之便而制造的小抽屉，随着时间的流逝，

en.t: For example, a small drawer made by a carpenter merely for household convenience, as time passes,

units.source_text: 时间凌驾于这物体的形态之上，历时数十年数百年后，

en.t: time comes to rise above the form of this object, and after decades or centuries have gone by,

units.source_text: 时间反而仿佛凝固起来而形成这物体的形态。

en.t: time itself, as if having solidified, seems instead to form the shape of the object.

units.source_text: 一定的小空间，起初被物体占据着，

en.t: A certain small space, at first occupied by an object,

units.source_text: 后来变为被凝结了的时间所占据。

en.t: later comes to be occupied by congealed time.

units.source_text: 它就是一种精灵的化身。

en.t: It is the embodiment of a kind of spirit.
